note: In 2000 - kneeling, packing the book bag
9-year-old girl - close, looks up
named Asha / packed a book bag - stands with bag on, turns to the door
left her house in the rain - walks out through the French door
really early in the morning - walking away under the umbrella
front three-quarter, face under the umbrella
a passing motorist saw her - car passes
walking along the highway - wide, car stopped ahead
he circled back / approached - she stops, looks at the car
Asha ran into - turns and runs off the road
the woods - running between trees
by daylight Asha was gone - wide, small figure disappears
leaving behind a few belongings - two searchers at the shed
in a nearby shed - searcher reads his clipboard
extensive searches - torches sweep the woods
no trace of her - closer, searcher walks forward
a year later - the wrapped bag, close
her book bag was found at a construction site - worker reaches
covered in a plastic bag - hand on the plastic, close
but it revealed nothing - worker looks at the bag
no one knows why she left - memory figure walks
or where she was going - side
her disappearance... - the framed portrait
unsolved cases in the United States - closer
